Predicates:
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
Nazi(x) ::: x is a Nazi.
German(x) ::: x is German.
MemberOfPrussianParliament(x) ::: x is a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
MemberOfReichstag(x) ::: x is a member of the Nazi Reichstag.
FOL ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
FOL ::: Heinrich Scmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
Politician(heinrich) ∧ Nazi(heinrich) ∧ German(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
MemberOfPrussianParliament(heinrich) ∧ MemberOfReichstag(heinrich) ::: Heeinrich Scmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Politician(x) ∧ MemberOfReichstag(x)) ::: No politicans are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
